invalidUrl: Enter a valid name and URL.
darkLightBg: Use light icon backgrounds in Dark Mode
screenTimeTracking: Track only the currently visible web page
widgetDragHint: Drag a widget to the desktop or the Widget Center on the right.
confirmDeleteApp: Are you sure you want to delete “{name}”?
widgetBatteryUnavailable: System battery is unavailable to the browser
weatherPerWidgetHint: Save multiple locations, then choose a location separately for each placed Weather widget.
widgetWeatherAddLocation: Add a weather location in Settings first
photoEventAppearance: When system appearance or desktop wallpaper changes
photoIndependentHint: Each Photo widget has its own photo source and change rules. A single photo never triggers a timed refresh.
noPhotoWidgets: No Photo widgets have been placed
addPhotoWidgetFirst: Add a Photo widget from the Widget Gallery first.
photoQuickHint: Manage this widget’s photo source and rotation rules in Widget settings.
widgetNoExtraSettings: This widget has no additional required settings.
limitDelayHint: When a limit is reached, media is paused and the page is obscured. You can extend by 5 minutes any number of times.
screenTimeNoData: No website activity has been recorded today.
dockFolderHint: These links appear to the right of the divider and use a unified folder icon.
batteryQuickHint: Shows the battery state that the browser can access for this computer.
emptyTrashQuestion: Are you sure you want to permanently erase the items in the Trash?
deletePermanentlyQuestion: Are you sure you want to permanently delete “{name}”?
developerModeHint: The other options on this page only apply while Developer Mode is on.
developerSecondsBaseHint: Numeric duration fields default to seconds.
developerDisableAnimationsHint: Turns off transitions and animations of windows, menus, widgets, the Dock and inside applications.
developerReduceTransparencyHint: Disables frosted glass and uses opaque system surfaces.
developerIncreaseContrastHint: Strengthens text, borders and control states.
developerAllowSystemIconsHint: Allows built-in items to change icon/background or move to Trash.
developerIncognitoHint: Changes made after enabling stay only in this tab. Turning this off restores the saved baseline.
developerLaunchpadLayoutHint: Override the automatic Launchpad layout in Developer Mode. Auto follows the window size.
pluginHint: Plugins can restyle the limit screen. Imports are validated and must implement the required “Delay 5 Minutes” action.
spotlightFocusOnOpenHint: Automatically focus the Spotlight search field on a new tab. Enabling this also forces “Show Spotlight on Startup” on.
builtInOverlayHint: Supports custom text, image, font, and sizing.
pluginInvalidRoot: The plugin root must be a JSON object.
pluginInvalidMeta: The plugin must provide id, name, and kind=limit-overlay.
pluginDelayRequired: The plugin must declare the delay5 action.
pluginDelayButtonRequired: The plugin UI must contain a data-macos-action="delay5" control.
developerTransparentGlass: Use transparency instead of frosted glass
developerTransparentGlassHint: Disables backdrop blur while keeping translucent surfaces to reduce GPU compositing cost.
developerDisableExtraFeaturesHint: Turns off widgets, applications and web time management and removes every way in to them. Existing settings and data are kept.
developerSelectableUITextHint: Allows interface text to be selected and copied. Off by default; drag controls still keep interaction priority.
applicationsHint: Application plugins run in an isolated sandbox and start only when opened. They can declare permissions and use private storage and macOS-style windows.
deleteApplicationPluginQuestion: Are you sure you want to uninstall “{name}”?
appPluginInvalidRoot: The application plugin root must be a JSON object.
appPluginInvalidMeta: An application plugin must provide id, name, and kind=app.
appPluginNoUI: The Web application is missing a valid entry.html file.
developerDisableStrictPluginSecurityHint: When on, you may set individual applications below to “Relaxed”: larger packages, external resources, heavier CSS and higher quotas, still inside an isolated sandbox. Applications you do not choose stay strict.
appPackageTooLarge: The application package exceeds the size allowed by the current security mode.
appPackageMissing: The application package is missing or damaged.
applicationOpenFailed: The application could not be opened.
windowNotResizable: This application window is not resizable
appPackageTooManyFiles: The application package contains too many files. This mode allows at most {count} files.
appPluginUnsupportedFormat: Applications must use the macos-app-package-v3 format.
appPluginInvalidNativeUI: The native application UI description is invalid.
appPluginNoEntry: Applications must use a valid entry + files directory structure.
appPluginNoNativeUI: Native applications must provide a valid entry.ui UI description file.
appAutoStartHint: Opens this application automatically whenever a new tab is opened. Can only be turned on here.
dropWallpaperDark: It will be used for the dark appearance.
dropWallpaperLight: It will be used for the light appearance.
dropConfigWarning: Your current settings will be overwritten.
dropUnsupported: “{name}” cannot be imported. Drop an image (wallpaper), an application package, an overlay plugin or a settings backup.
dropHintDesktop: Drop to import: an image becomes the wallpaper; packages, plugins and backups are installed
dropWrongType: This kind of file cannot be used here.
dropUnsupportedBasic: “{name}” cannot be imported. Drop an image (to use as wallpaper) or a settings backup.
dropHintDesktopBasic: Release to import: an image becomes the wallpaper, a backup restores settings
accentMulticolorHint: Multicolor: the system uses blue and each application uses its own accent color.
accentFixedHint: {name}: the system and every application use this color.
bingDailyDetail: Bing daily wallpaper · changes every day
bingArchiveFailed: This month’s wallpapers could not be loaded. Check the network and try again.
bingArchiveEmpty: No wallpapers for this month yet.
bingGalleryHint: Pick a month to browse its Bing daily wallpapers; click one to make it the desktop picture.
openLinksInNewTab: Open links in a new tab
openLinksInNewTabHint: Keeps this page open and loads web links in a new browser tab.
liveWallpaperHint: Choose a local video to loop as the desktop background; it always applies to both appearances. It is stored on this computer and never uploaded.
dropWallpaperLibrary: The picture is added to Your Photos in Wallpaper settings.
dropLiveWallpaperDetail: The video is stored on this computer and loops as the desktop background.
finderFavoriteUrlPrompt: Address of the web page to pin to the sidebar:
finderFavoriteNamePrompt: Name to show in the sidebar:
filesSkipped: These files could not be imported:
wallpaperScopeHint: Choose the appearance first, then pick a wallpaper below. A picture you choose is used only for the appearance selected here.
wallpaperDiffers: The two appearances use different wallpapers
bingWallHint: Changes every day and applies to both appearances.
developerMultiInstanceHint: By default each application has a single window. When on, the applications selected below can open further windows from the menu bar or the context menu of their Dock icon.
instanceAllowHint: Let this application have several windows open at once.
instanceShareStorageHint: On: further windows use the same data and files as the first one. Off: each further window has a separate set of its own.
storageAppsHint: Sizes include the application itself and the data and files it stored. An application's data can only be erased as a whole here; finer cleaning is offered by the application in its own settings.
storageSystemHint: System settings, custom icons, widget data and the first-paint cache.
storageEraseDetail: The application stays installed, but everything it stored is deleted and cannot be recovered. Its open windows are closed.
storageNoWallpapers: No photos or videos have been added. Built-in and Bing wallpapers take no space here.
storageRemoveUnusedDetail: This frees {size}. Wallpapers currently on the desktop are kept.
developerDevToolsHint: Records application logs, API calls and internal system events, and makes the Developer Tools window available: load and hot-reload an app from a folder, pack it for export, interface inspector, storage browser, simulated conditions, record and replay, permission use, system monitor and configuration inspector. Nothing is recorded while this is off.
developerSlowMotionHint: Slows every animation of windows, the Dock and applications so each step can be watched.
devLoadFailed: The application could not be loaded
devAppsNote: An application loaded from its source folder is installed like a package and reloaded whenever a file changes (while this page stays open; choose the folder again after reloading the page).
devInspectHint: Open a native application to see its interface tree here.
devPickNode: Click a node to see its properties.
devStorageNote: Changes here are written straight to storage. A running application usually reads its storage at launch and sees them after a reload.
devNoRenders: Nothing recorded yet. Use the desktop, the Dock or Launchpad.
devDiffOnly: Only what differs from the defaults
devClearCachesDetail: It is rebuilt the next time a new tab opens. Settings and data are not affected.
devNoDiff: The configuration is identical to the defaults.
developerUnrestrictedHint: When on, the security levels below gain “Unrestricted”: an application set to it runs without permission declarations, quotas, size limits or rate limits. It applies only to the applications you choose, one by one.
unrestrictedIntentDetail: This switch is only needed for an application you are developing or trust completely. Turning it on affects no application by itself: you still set an application’s security level to “Unrestricted” below, one by one. If a web page, a tutorial or another person told you to do this, cancel.
backupHint: Exports every setting as one JSON file. Data and files stored by applications are not included.
windowTiling: Tile windows by dragging them to screen edges
windowTilingHint: Drag a window to the left or right edge to fill that half of the desktop, or to the top to fill it all. Dragging it away gives it back its size.
missionControlHint: Lays out every open window side by side; click one to switch to it. Press ⌃↑ or F3, or use the Window menu.
spotlightAppsHint: Finds items in Launchpad, the Dock and on the desktop by name.
spotlightContentHint: Finds what applications offer, such as songs and books, and opens it in the application.
notificationDndHint: Banners are not shown. Notifications still arrive in Notification Center (click the clock in the menu bar).
notificationClearHistory: Clear all notifications in Notification Center
notificationAppsHint: When off, the application’s notifications show no banner and do not arrive in Notification Center.
developerTimeSpeedHint: Speeds up the clock to test what changes with time: automatic appearance, widgets, website time limits.
installRelaxedDetail: This application does not fit under strict security. Installed with relaxed security it may use a larger package, external resources and higher quotas, and still runs in the sandbox. Only do this for an application you trust.
devPerfCalls: More than {count} API calls within one second. Combining calls (ui.batch, a single storage.set) takes load off the main thread.
devReplayNote: What is recorded are the input events the system sends the application: control events, keys, menu commands, Spotlight results, clicks on its menu bar item and notifications. Replaying sends them again at the original pace, to bring the application back to the same state after its code changed. Text shown in fields does not follow; the values the application receives are the same.
devNoRecording: Nothing recorded yet. Choose an application and click Record.
developerForceRTLHint: Mirrors the whole interface and the layout of applications as for a right-to-left language, whatever the current language; the text itself keeps its own direction. For checking a layout without knowing such a language.
permissionSwitchHint: When off, features of the application that need this permission stop working.
storageImportQuestion: Replace all of “{name}”’s data with this archive?
storageImportDetail: Everything the application stores now is deleted and replaced with the contents of “{file}”. Its open windows are closed.
storageImportNotData: This file is not an exported application data archive.
storageImportWrongApp: This data belongs to “{name}” and cannot be imported into this application.
appWidgetUnavailable: This widget is not available now
appWidgetOpenHint: Open the application to fill this widget
subtitleHint: Applies to videos that applications play, such as videos with subtitles in Music. While one plays, drag the subtitles to where you want them.
permissionRestartDetail: The application is running. A change of permissions takes full effect the next time it opens.
permissionRequestDetail: These permissions are switched off in System Settings. You can switch them back on under Applications; the application then needs to be reopened.
escCloses: Close the Front Window with Esc
escClosesHint: Pressing Esc closes the window in front. Where an application uses Esc itself (closing a sheet, leaving a field), nothing changes.
devTaskNote: What an application does inside its own sandbox cannot be seen from here; this is what it costs the desktop: how often it calls the system, how much main-thread time the system spends on it, and the events it is sent.
devPerfNote: The last minute, one sample a second. A frame rate below the display’s refresh rate, or a slowest frame over 34 ms, means the desktop did not keep up at that moment.
